recommendedPlacements.workstream: Persistent Factory services (Rivet, OmniRoute, Beads Dolt)
recommendedPlacements.rationale: Only inventoried Docker host; services already live there. The recommendation is not 'move' — it is 'make this host boring': supervised tailscaled with recovery, console definitions completed (svc:dolt), Docker API listener contained (R-03), and an off-box backup of Rivet/Dolt state. Until availability is fixed, every downstream placement is provisional.

Keep short-term (it works, verified publicly), conditional on PBI-023 containment of the unauthenticated routes. Medium-term proposal for operator decision: move the gateway under a service manager (or onto grok-bot's Docker host) so restart ownership is a mechanism, not a person at a desk; and tag the node so svc:factory-gateway can replace the Funnel-only identity.

recommendedPlacements.workstream: Agent sessions — personal-agent / coordination / browser ops
recommendedPlacements.rationale: Muse's own computer: discovery, cross-machine coordination, evidence, browser operations, Linear/GitHub/PR work through working gh auth. Never a production service host (ephemeral, RAM-pressured).

Cursor + the canonical docs library + the strongest CPU/RAM + the operator physically present for identity steps. Precondition for full capability: gh re-login (R-10). Disk headroom (34.7 GB free) needs operator attention before big checkouts/builds.

By design, Rivet workers + Sandbox Agent belong beside the engine on grok-bot. Blocked on: host availability (R-01), Sandbox Agent stand-up (runs nowhere), ProjectSupervisor wiring, and a Port executionRunner registration. Do not route real work here until PBI-019-class verification passes.
GitHub Actions: green CI on exact SHA is the Factory accept path, and the standing rule routes every CLI spin-up through Actions. No local host should become a build dependency.

OmniRoute on grok-bot is THE provider by operator decision (2026-10-30). Consumers use the svc route with the vault key. There is no verified fallback route: when grok-bot is down, Factory inference is down (observed today). A fallback (second host or a cloud connection inside OmniRoute) is an operator architecture decision, recorded here as a recommendation to consider — not implemented.
